annotations.title: Clear all draft outcomes, leaving the section empty

description: Clear every outcome from a draft, leaving the stage deliberately empty — deterministic, no AI generation. Outcomes have no item-level delete, and confirm_outcomes requires at least one outcome, so this is the only way to record that the section was addressed and left empty. The emptied draft cannot be published as a new plan; bind the emptying onto an already-live plan with modify_active. Optional source_stage {stage: outcomes, version} returns 409 when stale.
name: yardstick_interview_plan_drafts_clear_outcomes
